proposals.rationale: Pool has no tuned XGB - only vanilla (#2, 0.508, depth 5 over-capacity). Transfer the winning shallow/regularized regime found by direct-QWK tuning of LGB/CAT to a third library. Cheapest source of genuinely new error structure for later blending.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.545-0.560; best shot at a <0.99-correlated member to escape the NNLS ceiling in a future blend.

proposals.rationale: Cross the two decorrelation axes never combined: the 17-feature view (only tried on LGB, #4) with the strongest pool model, tuned CAT (#1). Different model on different feature view yields the most orthogonal errors available without new tuning.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.555-0.565 (near #1); value is decorrelation - if OOF correlates <0.99 with #1, a later blend can move past 0.57066.

proposals.rationale: Seed-only variation (#22) produced a near-clone. Inject diversity structurally: aggressive row/column subsampling (0.65/0.5 vs tuned 0.95/0.71) changes which interactions each tree sees; more trees recover accuracy. Stochastic regularization, not a seed bag.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.545-0.558; goal is a diversified LGB whose fold-level errors differ from #0/#3 enough to add blend weight later.

proposals.rationale: Compose the two solo levers that each survived into strong blends but were never combined: depth-2 boundary push (#7, a champion member) and the 17-feature view (#4). Extra-shallow trees on the pruned view, n_estimators 500 to compensate.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.550-0.560; if the levers' decorrelation compounds, this replaces #7 as diversity member and lifts the next blend round.
